Als Social Media & Community Manager (m/w/d) entwickelst du unsere Social-Media-Präsenz weiter, produzierst relevanten Content und baust gleichzeitig die Community rund um unsere Standorte und Mieter aus.

Du bist nah an den Menschen, entdeckst Geschichten und verwandelst sie in Content, der Aufmerksamkeit schafft und Lust auf WORKBOX macht.

Deine Aufgaben:

Social Media & Content

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn

  • Planung, Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Posts, Reels, Stories und weiteren Contentformaten

  • Entwicklung neuer Formate und Ideen gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing

  • Foto- und Video-Content direkt an unseren WORK BOX-Standorten

  • Erstellung von Mieterportraits, Behind-the-Scenes-Content und Business Stories

  • Community Management und aktive Interaktion mit unserer Zielgruppe

  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unseres Content- und Redaktionsplans

  • Beobachtung relevanter Social-Media-Trends und Übertragung auf WORKBOX

  • Analyse der wichtigsten KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Followerentwicklung

Community & Events

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung unserer WORKBOX Community

  • Regelmäßiger Austausch mit unseren Mieter und Identifikation spannender Geschichten

  • Entwicklung kleiner Aktionen und Community-Formate an unseren Standorten

  • Unterstützung bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Events wie After Workbox, Breakfast Days, Barista Days oder saisonalen Aktionen

  • Begleitung der Events mit Social Content

  • Aktivierung unserer Mieter für gemeinsame Inhalte, Kooperationen und Aktionen

  • Entwicklung von Ideen, wie unsere Standorte stärker zu lebendigen Business Communities werden

Dein Profil:

Du musst nicht seit zehn Jahren Social Media machen. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Content verstehst, Menschen magst und Dinge umsetzt.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content, Community Management oder vergleichbaren Aufgaben

  • ein sehr gutes Gespür für Instagram und LinkedIn

  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit Smartphone, Foto und Video

  • Erfahrung mit Tools wie Canva, CapCut oder Adobe ist ein Plus

  • gutes Sprachgefühl und die Fähigkeit, kurze, relevante Texte zu schreiben

  • eigenständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Offenheit und Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen

  • Interesse an Start-ups, Unternehmertum, E-Commerce, Handwerk, Design und urbanem Business

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

  • gute Englischkenntnisse

Und vor allem: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Post vorgibt. Du siehst eine gute Geschichte – und machst etwas daraus.

Was dich bei Work Box erwartet:

Bei uns verwaltest du keinen anonymen Corporate-Account.

Du bekommst Zugang zu einer vielfältigen Business Community mit spannenden Unternehmen, Produkten und Persönlichkeiten – und damit jeden Tag neue Möglichkeiten für guten Content.

Dazu kommen:

  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen und neue Formate

  • kurze Entscheidungswege

  • direkter Austausch mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung

  • abwechslungsreiche Arbeit zwischen Content, Community und Events

  • mehrere spannende WORKBOX-Standorte in Berlin

  • Verantwortung statt langer Abstimmungsschleifen

  • die Möglichkeit, die Social-Media- und Community-Strategie von WORK BOX aktiv mitzuprägen

Über uns:

WORKBOX entwickelt flexible Business Spaces für die unterschiedlichsten Anforderungen moderner Unternehmen.

Vom E-Commerce-Unternehmen über Produktentwicklung und Kleinproduktion bis zum kreativen Atelier: Unsere Mieternutzen WORKBOX als Raum für ihre Geschäftsideen.

Genau diese Vielfalt wollen wir stärker sichtbar machen.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gerne direkt ein paar Beispiele, Accounts oder Inhalte, die zeigen, was du kannst.

Start: ab sofort
Anstellung: Festanstellung / Vollzeit
Arbeitsort: Berlin

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

As the partner business grows, there will be room to build a team in EMEA.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do in the role</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Honeycomb and AWS relationship in EMEA, working with AWS teams from the first meeting through deal close.</li> <li>Be the partner expert for EMEA sellers. title: Senior Fraud Operations Coordinator
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE&nbsp;<br></u></span></strong></p> <p>The Returns, Quality and Fraud team is seeking a highly independent, detail-oriented and proactive Senior Fraud Operations Coordinator to own fraud operations for Quince Europe. As the sole member of the Fraud team based in Europe, you will be the primary owner of all inbound fraud, chargeback, security and privacy activity for the region, working across every fraud system and tool to identify, investigate and resolve customer fraud. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, solution-driven and self-directed, with the judgment to make sound decisions and move work forward without day-to-day oversight from a manager or coworkers.</p> <p>The candidate should thrive in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment and be able to independently prioritize across live order monitoring, chargeback management, escalations and prevention initiatives. Because the majority of the team operates in US time zones, this person must be an outstanding communicator: proactively sharing updates, documenting decisions, escalating risks at the right time, and partnering across multiple teams and systems to synthesize data into clear narratives about customer behavior that drive effective resolutions and measurable fraud savings.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Regional Ownership &amp; Independent Operation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the end-to-end owner and single point of contact for all fraud inbound for Quince Europe, including fraud, security and privacy inboxes, escalations, chargebacks and active order monitoring queues</li> <li>Operate independently across all fraud systems, payment processors and internal tools, making day-to-day decisions without reliance on real-time manager or peer support</li> <li>Build and manage your own workflows, queues and prioritization to consistently meet SLAs as the sole regional resource</li> <li>Provide structured, asynchronous updates to US-based leadership and partners (e.g., daily/weekly summaries, escalation logs, KPI reporting), with clear hand-offs across time zones</li> <li>Exercise sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate, documenting rationale for key decisions</li> <li>Identify regional gaps in tooling, process or coverage and proactively propose and implement solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Investigations &amp; Escalations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead investigations into customer fraud activity across European markets, including credit card chargeback requests and suspicious activity escalations from Service, Auditing, Security, Privacy and other partners</li> <li>Triage and resolve fraud, security and privacy inbox requests within 24 hours</li> <li>Conduct account-level deep dives to identify linked behaviors, repeat offenders and coordinated abuse</li> <li>Act as a strong steward of the Quince brand, balancing fraud prevention with customer experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Chargeback &amp; Dispute Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage daily chargeback processing for Quince Europe across Stripe, Braintree, PayPal and any regional payment processors or methods</li> <li>Ensure all disputes are responded to and actioned a minimum of 14 calendar days prior to due dates</li> <li>Optimize representment documentation to improve dispute win rates</li> <li>Identify root causes driving chargebacks and recommend preventative controls</li> </ul> <p><strong>Active Order Monitoring &amp; Asset Protection</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct real-time review of high-risk and high-dollar transactions prior to fulfillment</li> <li>Investigate suspicious purchases across vulnerable categories such as gift cards, jewelry, 3P vendor products (e.g., Therabody, coffee makers) and gold bars</li> <li>Oversee order cancellations when fraud thresholds are met</li> <li>Coordinate shipment interception and asset recovery efforts with European carriers and fulfillment partners when necessary</li> <li>Track performance metrics including approval rates, cancellation rates, fraud loss prevented and recovery outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Detection, Reporting &amp; Legal Follow-Up</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify trends of abuse and systemic vulnerabilities across delivery, returns, gift card purchasing, referral programs and high-value SKUs, including patterns specific to European markets</li> <li>Partner with Analytics to develop robust reporting that streamlines insights and accelerates fraud detection and prevention efforts</li> <li>Extrapolate case-level findings into broader fraud themes and prevention strategies</li> <li>Partner with Legal to determine customer recourse strategy, including account closures, recovery actions and escalation frameworks, in line with applicable European regulations (e.g., GDPR, PSD2/SCA)</li> <li>Track savings and impact measurement tied to fraud prevention initiatives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional &amp; title: Senior Copywriter
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋. We’re setting the standard for growth in the brave new digital world, and we need great people to join our global team!</p></div><h3><strong>WHAT TO EXPECT:</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for a sharp, versatile <strong>Senior Copywriter</strong> to own copy across some of Phiture's biggest accounts, including one of Europe’s biggest mobile gaming companies, the USA’s largest retailer, a fintech that keeps families connected across borders, and a fast-growing productivity app.</p> <p>You'll join a close-knit creative pod, working side by side with our Creative Lead, designers and Growth Consultants. Together, you'll <strong>turn briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into conversion-focused copy</strong> that reaches millions of users in app stores around the world.</p> <p>This isn't copywriting in a vacuum. You'll see how your messaging performs, learn from every test and use those insights to make the next round sharper. You'll switch between very different brands, tones and formats, often within tight character limits and on deadlines tied to larger experiments. It's a role for a writer who cares as much about why copy works as how it sounds, and who wants to grow into ASO, experimentation and creative strategy.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own copy delivery across your assigned accounts, from brief interpretation through to final QA on production and market localisation</li> <li>Translate creative briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into clear, conversion-focused copy, and ask the right questions when context or objectives are missing</li> <li>Write across a range of formats, including: <ul> <li>App store metadata, screenshot captions and in-app events</li> <li>Promotional content, storyboards and CRM campaigns</li> </ul> </li> <li>Build deep knowledge of each client's brand, products, features and audiences, understanding not just what we're promoting, but why</li> <li>Switch confidently between distinct brand voices, formats and markets, keeping each brand's identity intact while leaving room for creative testing</li> <li>Partner closely with designers so that copy and visuals work towards the same objective</li> <li>Write English source copy that translates well, and adapt messaging for different English-speaking markets</li> <li>Use creative testing and performance results to shape your recommendations and bring new ideas to the table</li> <li>Present and explain your creative rationale in meetings, alongside the Creative Lead</li> <li>Brief, guide and review freelance copywriters when the workload calls for it</li> <li>Carry client feedback, brand preferences and past learnings into every new piece of work</li> <li>Run copy QA and proofreading, including checking final designs for accuracy, localisation and consistency</li> <li>Plan your own workload and capacity, flagging risks early so copy never holds up design, testing or launches</li> <li>Use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, with the judgement to critically edit what they produce</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL NEED:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Native-level English copywriting ability, with excellent grammar, editorial skills and exceptional attention to detail</strong></li> <li><strong>Proven experience in a senior copywriting role, writing compelling digital copy across different formats and brands</strong></li> <li><strong>Strategic and commercial thinking: you can find the real user benefit in a brief and explain why your copy will work, not just why it sounds good</strong></li> <li><strong>A strong portfolio that shows range across brand voices and clear, benefit-led messaging</strong></li> <li>Experience managing multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with full ownership of quality, priorities and delivery</li> <li>A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working closely with designers and strategists, and respond constructively to feedback</li> <li>Confident communication with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels</li> <li>Experience in a creative or digital agency, ideally in mobile, performance or growth marketing</li> <li>Experience with ASO, SEO, UX or performance copywriting is a plus, but not essential, we'll teach you the ASO side. What matters most is strong craft, curiosity and a real interest in how ASO works beyond the copy itself</li> <li>Curiosity about products, audiences and the data behind them</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of their age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We celebrate diversity and are excited about building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Influencer Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h3><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h3> <p>The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.</p> <h3><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in the<strong><em> </em></strong>UK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.</p> <p>The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.</p> <p>Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.</p> <h3><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance</li> <li>Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery</li> <li>Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team</li> <li>Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting</li> <li>Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards</li> <li>Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment</li> <li>Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities</li> <li>Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals</li> <li>Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team</li> <li>Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort</li> <li>Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy</li> <li>Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience</li> <li>A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them</li> <li>End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis</li> <li>Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms</li> <li>Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback</li> <li>Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement</li> <li>Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail</li> <li>Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£72,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£90,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.&nbsp; We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (Life Sciences practice)
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>CRA’s&nbsp;<strong><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2Findustries%2Flife-sciences%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cakimball%40crai.com%7Cea67c91398754dca094608ded2ba7e0c%7C4a156c19bc9441acaacf954686490869%7C0%7C0%7C639179895609780605%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=KsJhZhqtnMhJKdJrhhCfvbIxa7MQpmtL2vIB9OXdxAk%3D&amp;reserved=0">Life Sciences</a></strong> practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.</p> <p>Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries.&nbsp;Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.</p> <p>To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;</li> <li>Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;</li> <li>Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;</li> <li>Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;</li> <li>Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;</li> <li>Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;</li> <li>3-6 years previous consulting experience;</li> <li>Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;</li> <li>Proven staff and project management skills;</li> <li>Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;</li> <li>Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);</li> <li>Occasional travel required.</li> description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p>As a Security Engineer within the Security Operations team, you will help design, build, and continuously improve the technical capabilities that underpin how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats. You will work at the intersection of engineering and operations — helping turn security problems into scalable, automated solutions. Your core responsibilities will be to:</p> <ul> <li>Alert Investigation &amp; Triage: Investigate and triage security alerts from across our detection tooling, analysing logs, endpoint, identity, cloud, and network telemetry to determine impact and root cause. Work alongside the wider SOC to escalate and resolve confirmed threats, document findings clearly, and feed what you learn back into detections, tuning, and automation.</li> <li>Incident Response &amp; DFIR: Support the investigation and response to confirmed security incidents, applying digital forensics and incident response skills across endpoint, cloud, and identity data. Help with evidence collection and preservation, timeline reconstruction, containment, and root cause analysis, and contribute to post-incident reviews that turn lessons learned into improved detections and tooling.</li> <li>SIEM Engineering: Contribute to the engineering of our SIEM platform, including onboarding and normalising log sources, building and maintaining parsers, and supporting high-fidelity data pipelines that underpin detection and investigation. Help improve log coverage, data quality, and platform performance.</li> <li>Detection Engineering: Help develop and maintain a library of high-quality detections using a Detection as Code methodology — working with version control, peer review, and automated testing pipelines. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&amp;CK framework and contribute to improving coverage, precision, and resilience against evasion.</li> <li>AI-Augmented Security Operations: Help explore and apply AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities — including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritisation of detection content. Contribute to evaluating emerging AI tooling and embedding it responsibly into team workflows.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence Integration: Help consume and operationalise threat intelligence from internal and external sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, response playbooks, and hunting activities. Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to support a timely and structured flow of actionable intelligence into security operations.</li> <li>Threat Hunting: Take part in proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring to the role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a technically capable security professional with hands-on experience in security operations. Experience integrating these tools to support detection, investigation, and response workflows.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds, and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes. title: Commercial Counsel Fellowship
description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco. Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way. No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business. What you'll do Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance What you'll get Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team What you'll need A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts) 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers Operational mindset Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry Nice to have Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role Experience using AI tools in your own legal work Familiarity with how AI or software products are built FAQs Are there specific fellowship start dates or can I start anytime? We do not currently have specific start dates. Start dates can be year round. I am 10 years out of law school. Can I still apply for the fellowship? The fellowship is meant for early-career lawyers (first 3 years of legal practice). However, lots of lawyers take different, non-traditional paths. If you are an experienced lawyer who is early in your commercial counsel career, you are still welcome to apply. Explain your career transition and interest in commercial legal work in your application. Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates. Working at Runway Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you. raw.title: Commercial Counsel Fellowship
raw.description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

  • Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

  • Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work

  • Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team

  • Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance

 

What you'll get

  • Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on

  • Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work

  • Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team

  • A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video

  • Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team

 

What you'll need

  • A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts)

  • 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role

  • A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done

  • Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers

  • Operational mindset

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role

  • Experience using AI tools in your own legal work

  • Familiarity with how AI or software products are built

FAQs

  • Are there specific fellowship start dates or can I start anytime?

    • We do not currently have specific start dates. Start dates can be year round.

  • I am 10 years out of law school. Can I still apply for the fellowship?

    • The fellowship is meant for early-career lawyers (first 3 years of legal practice). However, lots of lawyers take different, non-traditional paths. If you are an experienced lawyer who is early in your commercial counsel career, you are still welcome to apply. Explain your career transition and interest in commercial legal work in your application.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Loft Orbital is looking for a Flight Dynamics Software Engineer to join the Ground Platform organization.

  • Enable new conops and customer missions with demanding orbit determination, stationkeeping, and attitude performance requirements

We're looking for someone with a solid theoretical understanding of astrodynamics, operational flight-dynamics experience, and software-engineering foundations. If you enjoy solving hard problems and working in a fast-paced and supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re hiring for one position across multiple locations - you only need to apply once.

  • Develop and maintain the in-house flight dynamics ground software backend applications that compute, store, and serve our fleet’s ephemerides, maneuvers, conjunctions, target orbits, etc

The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
description: Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives. Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles. Pourquoi ce recrutement ? Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas. Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence. Missions Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes. 1. Enquêter Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs. Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A . 2. Dévoiler Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an. Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites . Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média. Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain : Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat. Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l' onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes. 3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier. Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne. Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances. Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires , toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes. Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen , Commission européenne , Représentation permanente de la France , Assemblée nationale , Sénat , ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés. Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp. Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG. Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ». Compétences recherchées Indispensable Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction. Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer. Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre. Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets. Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll. De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits. Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués… Un vrai plus Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances. Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles). Une expérience d'animation de coalitions. Profil recherché Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine. Tu vas chercher toi-même. Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources. Tu arrives avec un dossier. Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui. Tu es crédible partout. Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram. Tu tiens la distance. Le plaidoyer est lent et échoue souvent. Un échec bien raconté ne te fait pas peur : il prépare la suite. Tu es rigoureux (mais genre, vraiment). Une seule affirmation fragile ruinerait la crédibilité de toutes les autres. Chaque chiffre est sourcé, chaque victoire attribuée à sa juste part. Tu es owner. Tes réussites comme tes échecs t'appartiennent. Tu avances même quand c'est flou. Tu veux un impact réel. Changer les règles, pas seulement en parler. Le package Lieu : Paris, avec des déplacements réguliers. Contrat : CDI, statut cadre Arrivée : ASAP BSPCEs (equity) RTTs Mutuelle santé Alan Déplacements à Bruxelles pris en charge Une journée d'équipe tous les semestres Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer. description: Handicap International (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 59 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons 4000 employés dans le monde.   Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens. Au sein de l’équipe communication de Handicap International France, vous participerez au développement et à l’animation des communautés de l’organisation sur les réseaux sociaux (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, etc.), en lien étroit avec le community manager et le social media manager. Vous contribuerez à faire vivre les échanges avec les internautes, à identifier les sujets susceptibles de susciter leur intérêt et à adapter les prises de parole de l’association aux usages des différentes plateformes. Vous participerez à la recherche de nouvelles idées éditoriales, à la conception de formats adaptés aux réseaux sociaux et à la valorisation des actions de l’organisation auprès du grand public. Vous prendrez également part à la préparation et à la coordination de la diffusion des publications, ainsi qu’à une veille sur les tendances numériques, les conversations en ligne et les initiatives d’autres acteurs du secteur. Enfin, vous contribuerez au suivi des interactions et à l’analyse des performances des contenus afin de dégager des enseignements et de proposer des pistes d’amélioration. Ce stage vous permettra de découvrir les enjeux de l’animation de communautés numériques au sein d’une ONG internationale et de participer à des actions de communication visant à sensibiliser le public, encourager l’engagement citoyen et faire connaître les combats de Handicap International en faveur des droits des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables. Activité 1 : Développement et animation des communautés en ligne Participation à l’animation des espaces d’échange de Handicap International France sur les réseaux sociaux. Identification des sujets de conversation et des besoins de la communauté, suivi des interactions et contribution à la qualité des échanges avec les internautes. Activité 2 : Conception éditoriale et adaptation des contenus social media Contribution à la recherche d’idées et à la proposition de formats adaptés aux usages des différentes plateformes. Participation à la rédaction de publications, à la déclinaison de contenus existants et à la création de formats engageants en lien avec l’actualité, les campagnes et les missions de l’organisation. Activité 3 : Coordination opérationnelle de la diffusion social media Participation à la préparation et à l’organisation des publications : mise à jour du calendrier éditorial, adaptation des messages aux spécificités des plateformes, préparation des éléments nécessaires à leur diffusion et suivi de leur bonne mise en ligne via Agorapulse. Activité 4 : Veille des conversations numériques et suivi de l’engagement Observation des tendances, des pratiques des autres organisations et des discussions en ligne autour des thématiques portées par Handicap International. Contribution à l’analyse des réactions et des performances des publications, à la réalisation de bilans et à l’identification de recommandations pour améliorer les interactions et l’engagement des communautés. title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
description: McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle. Vos missions Votre mission Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing) Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale. Vos principales responsabilités Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ; Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ; Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ; Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ; Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ; Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ; Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ; Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ; Tenir à jour la documentation interne ; Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures. Organisation du travail et horaires Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe. Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ; À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ; Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ; Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation. Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit. L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends. Vos compétences Profil recherché Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ; Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ; Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ; Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ; Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ; Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ; Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ; Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail. Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise. La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne. Avantages Conditions proposées CDI à temps plein annualisé ; Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ; Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ; Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ; Formation technique assurée en interne ; Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd. Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. raw.description:
Shape the future of bioanalysis for innovative medicines

 

Celerion is one of the world's leading bioanalytical contract research organizations and has been supporting pharmaceutical and biotech drug development programs around the world for more than 40 years.

To strengthen our bioanalytical laboratory in the Ligand Binding Service Team in Fehraltorf / Zurich, we are looking for a

                                    (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator (100%)*

 

In this role, you will take scientific and operational ownership of regulated bioanalytical studies and method validations. You will serve as the primary client contact, lead study execution from planning through reporting, and play a key role in delivering high-quality data to support drug development programs worldwide.

 

* This is a dual-level posting. The hiring team will determine the final level and title of the role based on the skills, experience, and capabilities required for the level offered.

Main responsibilities

Study Leadership & Scientific Oversight

  • Lead and oversee GLP/GxP-compliant bioanalytical studies and method validations within the Ligand Binding Services (LBS) department.
  • Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.
  • Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.
  • Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.

Client Management

  • Serve as the primary scientific and operational contact for assigned clients.
  • Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.

Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.
  • Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.
  • Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.
  • Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.

Additional Responsibilities for Senior-Level Candidates

  • Lead complex or strategic client programs.
  • Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for ligand-binding and cell-based assay technologies.
  • Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.

Our requirements

  • BSc / MSc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology or related field
  • At least 2 years professional experience, at least 6 years for senior position
  • Practical experience in relevant bioanalytical techniques (e.g. LBA, cell-based), preferably in an industry setting
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail
  • Excellent computer and time management skills
  • Highly self-motivated, reliable, and flexible, with a commitment to providing excellent service to clients.
  • Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions
  • Excellent English (written and spoken), good German skills are advantageous
  • Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role is required for the senior position
  • Knowledge of biomarker, pharmacokinetic (PK), immunogenicity (ADA) or biologics bioanalysis
  • Experience working directly with pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients is advantageous

 

Your chance

We provide an opportunity to assume work independently, secure long-term employment, and enjoy a competitive salary.

Your workplace will be located within our state-of-the-art equipped automated facilities in cantone Zurich as part of an international organization. 

Additionally, you will experience the advantages of flexible working hours and experience the benefits of a medium-sized company with flat organizational structure within a dynamic and international team.

Our benefits: extra holidays, company-paid sickness and accident insurance, commuting allowance and access to Reka-Checks.
